name: Duplicate It – Post & Page Duplicator for WordPress
author: Smartz Minds

sections.description:
Duplicate It is a powerful yet lightweight duplicate post plugin for WordPress that lets you instantly duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types in just one click.

Whether you want to duplicate a post in WordPress, clone a page, or bulk duplicate content, this plugin makes the process fast, simple, and reliable.

It automatically detects popular page builders like Elementor and Gutenberg, ensuring your duplicated content works perfectly without breaking layouts.

Save time, reuse designs, and scale content faster without rebuilding pages from scratch.

🚀 Why Use Duplicate It?

  • One-click duplicate post & page for instant cloning
  • Bulk duplicate WordPress content in seconds
  • Duplicate custom post types (CPT) easily
  • Works seamlessly with Elementor and Gutenberg
  • Set duplicate status: draft, publish, private or pending
  • Auto rename titles with prefix/suffix like “Copy”
  • Create multiple copies in one click
  • Lightweight & fast performance without slowing your site

🔥 Key Features

  • Duplicate posts, pages and custom post types easily
  • One-click duplication directly from WordPress dashboard
  • Bulk duplicate multiple posts or pages at once
  • Works perfectly with Elementor and Gutenberg
  • Choose duplicate status: draft, published, private, or pending
  • Add prefix/suffix like “Copy” or “Draft” automatically
  • Create multiple copies of content in one go
  • Stay or redirect after duplication as per preference
  • Quick duplicate option under posts & pages list
  • Role-based access support

💡 Use Cases

  • Clone landing pages built with Elementor
  • Duplicate blog posts for updates or A/B testing
  • Create reusable templates quickly
  • Bulk duplicate pages for large websites
  • Copy WooCommerce or custom post type content

⚡ Why Choose Duplicate It?

Unlike heavy duplicate plugins, Duplicate It focuses on speed, simplicity, and performance.

  • No unnecessary features
  • No ads or clutter
  • Clean and fast duplication process
  • Perfect for developers, bloggers, and agencies

📌 How to Duplicate a Post or Page in WordPress

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to “Posts” or “Pages”
  3. Click the “Duplicate” link below any item
  4. Your duplicate will be created instantly
  5. Use Bulk Actions to bulk duplicate multiple items

Video Tutorial:

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best duplicate post plugin for WordPress?

Duplicate It is a lightweight and fast duplicate post plugin that allows you to duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types instantly.

How do I duplicate a post in WordPress?

Simply install Duplicate It, go to Posts, and click the Duplicate link under any post.

How do I duplicate a page in WordPress?

Go to Pages and click the Duplicate option below the page title.

Can I bulk duplicate posts in WordPress?

Yes, you can select multiple posts and use the Bulk Actions → Duplicate option.

Does this plugin support Elementor?

Yes, Duplicate It automatically detects Elementor and ensures proper duplication.

Can I duplicate custom post types?

Yes, it supports all custom post types (CPT).

Can I choose the duplicate post status?

Yes, you can set it as draft, published, private, or pending.

Is Duplicate It plugin free?

Yes, it is completely free and lightweight.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 3.4+
  • PHP 5.x
  • MySQL 5.x

If any problem occurs, please contact us at support@smartzminds.com
